rationale: The agent submitted return requests without first confirming with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action. It also did not attempt or clarify the user’s specific request to refund each order to the opposite order’s payment method, nor did it explain any limitation or hand off to a human if cross-refunds were not possible. Additionally, it stated card details (last four digits) without visible tool evidence. While it acted on the user’s account and returned all items, the lack of confirmation, failure to follow the requested refund routing, and potentially unsupported payment detail make this a fail.
